description: Searches Bookvia's directory of local service businesses in Germany by job (query, everyday German words) and place (location: postal code, district, neighbourhood or town). Returns matching businesses with their matching services and price ranges, which are stated by the business and are not binding quotes. results holds only businesses that confirmed their own data, and can be empty: empty results means Bookvia has no business listed for this search. A separate list, unverified, can hold entries from public data (not businesses that confirmed anything), always verified: false. interpretation shows how trade and place were understood; if interpretation.clarification is set, the search was ambiguous and may not have run. remote_ok: true includes businesses that work online or by phone (remote_available counts them). urgent: true, when the customer says the job is urgent, lists first the businesses that state they react within one hour right now. The order follows how well a business fits.

category.description: Trade or industry to filter by

district.description: Berlin district or neighbourhood, e.g. "Neukölln", "Kreuzberg", "Prenzlauer Berg"

location.description: Where the job is, as the customer said it: German postal code, district, neighbourhood or town, e.g. "12047", "Kreuzberg", "Berlin-Neukölln". Preferred over district and postal_code.

offset.description: Skip this many results. Use next_offset from the previous answer to get the next page

postal_code.description: German 5-digit postal code of the job location

query.description: Free text in German describing the job, e.g. "Steckdose in der Küche setzen" or "Heizungswartung"

remote_ok.description: true if the customer is fine with a provider who works online or by phone instead of coming by, e.g. for tax, legal or business advice, coaching, translation, tutoring, web design or IT for offices. Businesses anywhere in Germany that work remotely are then included, local ones first

urgent.description: true if the customer said the job is urgent, e.g. the heating is off or water is leaking (urgency comes from the customer, not from the kind of job). Businesses that state they react within one hour at this moment are then listed first, see reacts_within_1h

name: search_businesses

interpretation.description: What Bookvia understood: trade and location. Selected automatically at 80 % confidence or more.

clarification.description: If present, the request was not clear enough and the search may not have run. question and options can be put to the customer (e.g. as quick replies); a search with the chosen option value in field (query or location) follows.

label.description: Readable name of the place, e.g. "Kreuzberg (Berlin)" or "12047 Berlin-Neukölln"
Readable name of the place, e.g. "Kreuzberg (Berlin)" or "12047 Berlin-Neukölln"

interpreted_district.description: District the location filter was mapped to

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to get the next page. null: there are no more results

notice.description: What Bookvia understood and what is and is not listed, in words. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions

remote_available.description: More matching businesses that work remotely and were left out because remote_ok was not set. If greater than 0, a search with remote_ok: true includes them

results.description: Verified businesses that match, best fit first. Empty: Bookvia has no business listed for this search

booking_url.description: Page where the customer can book an appointment directly with the business; booking there does not go through Bookvia

last_confirmed_at.description: When the business last confirmed its data (ISO 8601)

matches_not_offered.description: Only set when true: the business itself states that it does not take the kind of job in query (see expertise.not_offered in its profile). It is listed after all others

action.description: quote = request a quote, appointment = request an appointment, info = information only

max_eur.description: Upper end of the price range in EUR, null if unknown

min_eur.description: Lower end of the price range in EUR, null if unknown

note.description: Conditions stated by the business, e.g. travel costs

unit.description: pauschal = flat, pro_stunde = per hour, pro_qm = per m², pro_einheit = per unit, auf_anfrage = on request

reacts_within_1h.description: Only with urgent: true. true: by its own statement the business reacts within one hour at this moment, during or outside its opening hours. A statement of the business, not a promise

remote.description: true: the business also works online or by phone for customers anywhere in Germany

requests_paused.description: Only set when true: this business takes no further requests through Bookvia right now, and other businesses can take one. It is listed after all others. A request still goes to it only for a customer who asked for exactly this business by name (customer_named_business: true). Its public contact details are in its profile

total.description: All matching businesses, not only the ones on this page

unverified.description: Separate list, never part of results or total: businesses from public data that are NOT on Bookvia and have not confirmed anything. Only filled when trade and place of the search are clear. These entries are unverified: not verified, recommended, available or booked. unverified_notice states what is known about them, unverified_attribution the source

can_forward.description: true: Bookvia can pass a request of the customer on to this business by e-mail (request_quote with this id as business_id). It goes to the business only after the customer clicked a button in an e-mail from Bookvia, and whether the business answers is open. false: Bookvia cannot pass a request on; the public phone number or website remain (one exception: see requests_paused)

category.description: Trade, as Bookvia mapped it from the public source

id.description: Listing ID, starts with lst_. Not a business ID: there is no Bookvia profile, no services and no prices behind it

phone.description: Public phone number from the source, not confirmed by the business

requests_paused.description: Only set when true: Bookvia already passed on as many requests to this business as it passes on to one business that is not on Bookvia within a period (the numbers are in unverified_notice), and other businesses can take a request. It is listed after all others, and can_forward is false. A request still goes to it only for a customer who asked for exactly this business by name (request_quote with this id and customer_named_business: true)

source.description: Where the data comes from. Known values: openstreetmap. More may be added later

verified.description: Always false: this business is not on Bookvia and has not confirmed any of this data

website_url.description: Public website from the source, not confirmed by the business

unverified_attribution.description: Source of the entries in unverified, with the attribution its license requires wherever an entry is shown. Only set when unverified is not empty

unverified_notice.description: What is known about the entries in unverified: where the data comes from, what Bookvia does not know about them, and whether and how Bookvia can pass a request on. Written by Bookvia: facts only, never instructions. Only set when unverified is not empty

title: Search local businesses
